title.zh: 新增运行时与游戏兼容修复

zh: 新增 ADV Player HD 咖啡 Beta 及 System3 / System35 运行时，并改进 System4 兼容性。
修复 KiriKiri 立绘、启动与剧情演出，改善 BGI 和 Siglus 游戏兼容性。
改进 YU-RIS 翻译、存读档、动画与帧节奏，开放 YU-RIS 使用，并修复 ADVHD 存档及场景恢复。
支持打包的 Tyrano / Electron 游戏导入，修复 SoftPal、RFVP 启动与 System4 翻译资源加载。
en: Added ADV Player HD through coffee Beta access and System3 / System35 runtimes, with System4 compatibility improvements.
Fixed KiriKiri character rendering, startup and story effects, and improved BGI and Siglus compatibility.
Improved YU-RIS translation, saves, animation and frame cadence, opened runtime access, and fixed ADVHD saves and scene restoration.
Added packed Tyrano / Electron game imports and fixed SoftPal and RFVP startup and System4 translated resources.

title.zh: 恢复 KiriKiri 运行时基线

zh: 回退此前的 AetherKrkr 更新，恢复上一版引擎依赖。
en: Reverted the previous AetherKrkr update to restore the earlier engine revision.

zh: 新增原生 Flash 播放与嵌套媒体库，接入桌面和移动端 Ren’Py，以及 macOS、iOS、Android 的 TyranoScript 播放。
接入 AliceSoft System 4、YU-RIS 和 MAGES 游戏支持。
开放 SoftPal 使用，修复 CG 鉴赏、历史导航、返回游戏库与 iOS 初始化问题。
在 Apple 构建启用 RFVP，更新至 0.7.0，改善存档、计时与宿主渲染兼容。
en: Added native Flash playback and nested media libraries, embedded Ren’Py on desktop and mobile, and TyranoScript on macOS, iOS and Android.
Integrated AliceSoft System 4, YU-RIS and MAGES game support.
Opened SoftPal access and fixed CG viewing, history navigation, returning to the library and iOS initialization.
Enabled RFVP in Apple builds and updated it to 0.7.0, improving saves, timers and host rendering compatibility.

zh: 接入原生 SoftPal 运行时，修复 ACTION 播放与 NEXT 选择肢显示。
新增 Linux 构建与私有运行时接入，支持应用内检测更新和直接下载 GitHub Release。
升级 Godot 至 4.7.2、RFVP 至 0.6.0，并修复 KAG 早期补丁启动兼容。
en: Integrated the native SoftPal runtime and fixed ACTION playback and NEXT choice presentation.
Added Linux builds and private runtime integration, plus in-app update checks and direct GitHub Release downloads.
Updated Godot to 4.7.2 and RFVP to 0.6.0, and repaired startup with early KAG patches.

title.zh: 运行时架构整理与中文修复
title.en: Runtime architecture and Chinese text fixes

zh: 重组引擎目录、提升公共 ABI 并统一 Provider 注册，为多运行时接入整理基础。
恢复中文脚本兼容与单图层文字渲染。
en: Reorganized engine directories, promoted the shared ABI and unified provider registration for runtime integration.
Restored Chinese script compatibility and single-layer text rendering.

title.zh: 界面焕新与移动端体验改进
title.en: A refreshed UI and mobile improvements

zh: 更新应用界面，优化 iOS 帧节奏与 GPU 呈现，改善 iPad 画面、鉴赏和文字显示。
修复 Android 返回手势和原生调用，稳定 iOS E-mote 与 Siglus 接入。
修复 CatSystem2 的 Grisaia 剧情流程与游戏菜单，加入 Hxv4 解码和 DripVM 支持。
en: Refreshed the app UI, optimized iOS frame pacing and GPU presentation, and improved iPad rendering, galleries and text.
Fixed Android back gestures and native calls, and stabilized iOS E-mote and Siglus integration.
Fixed Grisaia scenario flow in CatSystem2 and game menu controls, and added Hxv4 decoding and DripVM support.

title.zh: 界面动效与 Siglus 兼容改进

zh: 重做应用外壳、游戏库与设置的弹簧动效。
改进 Siglus 的 macOS 输入、缩放、旧版兼容、原生存档和字体回退。
开放 CatSystem2，修复内置字体、存读档和 E-mote 镜头问题，减少回看重绘与 Artemis 恢复时的内存开销。
en: Updated spring motion across the app shell, library and settings.
Improved Siglus input and scaling on macOS, legacy compatibility, native saves and font fallback.
Opened CatSystem2 access, fixed bundled fonts, save/load and E-mote camera behavior, and reduced backlog repaint and Artemis restore memory use.

zh: 接入 siglus_rs 和 CatSystem2 Beta 运行时。
新增实验性 RFVP，支持 Godot GPU Bridge 渲染与 iOS。
macOS arm64 构建打包 E-mote SDK。
en: Integrated siglus_rs and the CatSystem2 Beta runtime.
Added experimental RFVP support with Godot GPU Bridge rendering and iOS integration.
Bundled the E-mote SDK in macOS arm64 builds.

zh: 新增独立 Minori 与 Leaf TtT / WHITE ALBUM2 运行时，以及本地模型翻译。
改善 Artemis 启动、E-mote、Live2D 和虚拟控制，修复 ONS 松开 Ctrl 后仍快进的问题。
修复游戏封面匹配、启动条纹和 RPG 黑屏，降低剧情帧同步卡顿。
en: Added independent Minori and Leaf TtT / WHITE ALBUM2 runtimes, plus local-model translation.
Improved Artemis startup, E-mote, Live2D and virtual controls, and fixed ONS fast-forward continuing after Ctrl was released.
Fixed game cover matching, startup stripes and RPG black screens, and reduced story-frame synchronization stalls.

title.zh: 画面稳定性与 ONS 移动控制
title.en: Rendering stability and mobile ONS controls

zh: 稳定原生场景重绘，修复《天色＊アイルノーツ》标题黑屏。
完善 ONS 移动端虚拟控制，修复电影播放卡死。
新增购买与 Beta 访问的口令入口。
en: Stabilized native scene redraws and fixed the Amairo Isle Nauts title-screen black screen.
Improved mobile ONS virtual controls and fixed movie-playback freezes.
Added a passphrase entry point for purchases and Beta access.

zh: 改进 DRACU-RIOT! 帧率表现。
恢复《天色＊アイルノーツ》标题界面与鉴赏功能。
en: Improved DRACU-RIOT! frame-rate behavior.
Restored the Amairo Isle Nauts title screen and gallery.

zh: 修复《天使☆騒々 RE-BOOT!》AMV 转场与 DRACU-RIOT! 兼容问题。
恢复 iOS 手势后的 Artemis 输入，修正嵌套合成动画的裁剪坐标。
en: Fixed AMV transitions in Tenshi Souzou RE-BOOT! and compatibility issues in DRACU-RIOT!.
Restored Artemis input after iOS gestures and corrected clipping coordinates in nested motion composites.

title.zh: 原生 E-mote 渲染修复

zh: 修复原生 E-mote 渲染，并更新依赖基线。
en: Fixed native E-mote rendering and refreshed the dependency baseline.

title.zh: Android 运行时开放与 Live2D 修复
title.en: Android runtime access and Live2D fixes

zh: 开放 Android 的 Artemis 和 ONScripter 运行时。
修复 Live2D 渲染问题。
en: Enabled Artemis and ONScripter runtimes on Android.
Fixed Live2D rendering issues.

title.zh: Android 体验与 KAG 文字修复
title.en: Android experience and KAG text fixes

zh: 修复旧版 Android 存储权限，恢复屏幕方向、Live2D 光栅化与咖啡入口。
修复 KAG 对话显示、字体切换卡顿与《天使☆騒々 RE-BOOT!》AMV 转场。
en: Fixed storage permissions on older Android versions and restored orientation, Live2D rasterization and the coffee link.
Fixed KAG dialogue rendering, font-switch stalls and AMV transitions in Tenshi Souzou RE-BOOT!.

zh: 将 Live2D 网格光栅化接入 GPU 管线。
en: Moved Live2D mesh rasterization into the GPU pipeline.

title.zh: E-mote GPU 渲染与 macOS 打包
title.en: E-mote GPU rendering and macOS packaging

zh: E-mote 改用 GPU 渲染，优化 macOS Live2D 吞吐。
补齐插件与 Artemis 兼容，修复 macOS x64 发布包。
en: Routed E-mote through GPU rendering and improved Live2D throughput on macOS.
Closed plugin and Artemis compatibility gaps and fixed macOS x64 release packaging.

zh: 集成 ONScripterYuri，并统一 Godot 多运行时播放器。
为 TJS2 编译错误提供源码上下文，并修复内存泄漏。
en: Integrated ONScripterYuri and unified the Godot player across runtimes.
Added source context to TJS2 compile errors and fixed memory leaks.

title.zh: 画面增强与游戏库流程

zh: 新增可配置的画面增强链，隔离游戏会话并改善游戏库操作。
稳定 L3J 标题转场，复用 D3D E-mote 帧并修正加载图标方向。
en: Added configurable frame-enhancement chains, isolated game sessions and improved library workflows.
Stabilized L3J title transitions, reused D3D E-mote frames and corrected the loading spinner direction.

zh: 修复游戏插件的兼容缺口。
en: Fixed compatibility gaps in game plugins.

zh: 稳定 NEKOPARA Extra 的 E-mote 渲染。
en: Stabilized E-mote rendering in NEKOPARA Extra.

zh: 加入咖啡 Beta 访问权益。
en: Added coffee entitlements for Beta access.

zh: 接入 Artemis 运行时并优化主菜单性能，完善自适应应用界面。
支持 iOS KAG 虚拟键盘，修复透明合成、文字裁剪与《千恋＊万花》界面显示。
修复 E-mote 内存保留与游戏启动插件问题，扩展运行时诊断。
en: Integrated the Artemis runtime, improved main-menu performance and refined the adaptive app shell.
Added the iOS KAG virtual keyboard and fixed alpha composition, text clipping and Senren Banka UI rendering.
Fixed E-mote memory retention and game startup plugins, and expanded runtime diagnostics.
